design: Run locally, next to credentialed data (see sim2/e6_mimic_cohort.py). The script writes figures/merged_expE6.json and figures/fig7_mimic.pdf (with copies in aaai/figures/) only when the cohort comes from MIMIC-IV and has at least --min-admissions admissions; --tag writes merged_expE6_<tag>.json and fig7_mimic_<tag>.pdf instead, for sensitivity runs. Cohorts built from the synthetic fixture (sim2/e6_fixture.py) or the demo are refused unless --output and --figure point elsewhere.
simulated_components: deployment of a logistic score fitted to part of the early period
alert threshold at a 10% alert rate on that part
clinician response to alerts (acted upon with probability 0.85)
effect of the alert-triggered action (prevents an event with probability 0.5, never causes one)
randomised unalerted arm (30% of post-deployment patients)
real_components: outcome under historical care (sepsis onset within 12 h)
hospital system (B before deployment, A after)
